tools.name: search_builders
tools.description: Find public software developer profiles on codercops by skill. Returns a short card per builder with their public profile URL. Profile text is written by the builder.

tools.name: get_builder
tools.description: One builder's full public profile: bio, skills, self-declared rate, projects, work history, education and credentials. Profile text is written by the builder.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Open software jobs on codercops, searched by keywords and filtered by category and tech stack. Returns a card per job with its URL, best matches first. Job text is written by the hiring company.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One open job in full: description, requirements, budget and company.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: A hiring company's public page and its open roles.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: What is free on codercops, what costs credits and how much, the credit packs, and the managed recruiting terms.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_builder" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: One builder's full public profile: bio, skills, self-declared rate, projects, work history, education and credentials. Profile text is written by the builder.
